title: The First Side-Hustle Dollar Needs Its Own Home

beats.say: The first dollar your side hustle earns should not touch your checking account.
beats.visual: extreme close-up of a $1 bill on a rain-slick sidewalk, sodium light bleeding in from above

beats.say: Mix it, and taxes become a nightmare.
beats.visual: a blurred 1040 form under a single fluorescent light, shadows stretching across the desk

beats.say: Big question: where does that money go so it doesn’t disappear?
beats.visual: low-angle shot of an open bank envelope, empty, against a dark sky

beats.say: Most people dump it in their main account.
beats.visual: a cluttered desk with scattered receipts, shot from above at blue hour

beats.say: Here’s the truth: a separate account and a simple record save hours and dollars.
beats.visual: a single savings account passbook on a Ridge line, wind flipping the pages

beats.say: Step one. Open a free business checking account today.
beats.visual: extreme wide of an empty bank branch at night, single light in the distance

beats.say: Step two. Move your first side-hustle dollar in there the second it lands.
beats.visual: a hand sliding a dollar into an envelope, shot in silhouette against a tower edge

beats.say: Step three. Log it in a spreadsheet: date, amount, source.
beats.visual: a laptop screen at a steep angle, only a glowing spreadsheet visible, cold fluorescent

beats.say: Now you’re tracking. Now you’re ready.
beats.visual: an open ledger on a wet asphalt surface, rain falling in slow motion

beats.say: That $1,000 a month extra, invested for 10 years at 8%, turns into $182,946.
beats.visual: a tiny figure standing on a ridge line, looking down at a city’s lights below

beats.say: But only if you keep it separate from day one.
beats.visual: extreme close-up of a door slamming shut on a stack of bills, shot in low light

beats.say: Follow for the money rules nobody taught you.
beats.visual: an empty highway at night, taillights disappearing into the distance

caption:
Separate your side hustle money today. Here’s how in 15 minutes.
#SideHustle #TaxTips #MoneyRules
